_comment: Edit thresholds here; no code change needed. Rules: match (abs tol, partial at 2x tol), match_rel (relative tol), at_most / at_least (pass and partial thresholds; pass may be derived from the lunar target), unscored (shown, never scored), evidence (Earth-side data only, at best partial). In a test, an unknown core requirement makes the whole test unknown; an unknown 'supporting' requirement is only counted.
cannot_reproduce: Gravity: the Moon has 1/6 of Earth's gravity; mobility, excavation forces and dust behaviour differ.
Vacuum: no Earth field site removes the atmosphere (convection, dust settling, outgassing).
Radiation: no Earth site reproduces the lunar surface radiation environment.
Regolith mechanics: lunar regolith is sharp, glassy and electrostatically charged; no natural soil matches it.
Thermal extremes: permanently shadowed floors sit near 40-50 K; the coldest Earth surfaces are about 180 K warmer.

slope.label: Slope distribution (95th percentile)
slope.caveat: Earth DEM is 30 m resampled to ~90 m, LOLA is 80 m; rover-scale rocks and small craters are not resolved.

roughness.label: Terrain roughness (RMS height over ~400 m)
roughness.caveat: Roughness is measured at ~90 m spacing; it says nothing about rover-wheel scale roughness.

bare_ground.label: Bare ground (yearly max NDVI)
bare_ground.caveat: MODIS NDVI is not produced for Devon Island and McMurdo, so they show unknown here although both are polar deserts.

low_sun.label: Low-sun days (noon sun between 0 and 10 deg)
low_sun.target_text: sun stays within ~2 deg of the horizon
low_sun.caveat: Earth day length and atmosphere differ; the lighting match is approximate (computed from latitude only).

deep_cold.label: Coldest night surface temperature
deep_cold.caveat: No Earth site reaches lunar polar temperatures; a partial means deep-cold testing is possible, not that lunar cold is reproduced.

thermal_swing.label: Surface temperature swing over a year
thermal_swing.caveat: Earth swings are seasonal and buffered by air; lunar swings are driven by direct sunlight in vacuum.

frozen_ground.label: Mean surface temperature below freezing
frozen_ground.target_unit: share of area with stable ice
frozen_ground.caveat: A cold mean only makes frozen ground plausible; Earth permafrost ice is not lunar cold-trap ice.

radar_ice.label: Radar signature of ice-rich ground
radar_ice.caveat: Mini-RF is S-band polarization ratio, Sentinel-1 is C-band backscatter: the two are not comparable, so this is shown but not scored.

minerals.label: Surface mineral map available (EMIT)
minerals.caveat: EMIT covers arid low and mid latitudes only, and the lunar pole has no reliable mineral layer: this is Earth-side evidence, never a match.
